name: sp_139_Normalized

schema.description: Schema for the anonymous IP enrichment produced by Maxmind

is_anonymous.description: True if the IP belongs to any sort of anonymous network.

is_anonymous_vpn.description: True if the IP address is registered to an anonymous VPN provider. If a VPN provider does not register subnets under names associated with them, we will likely only flag their IP ranges using the is_hosting_provider flag.

is_hosting_provider.description: True if the IP address belongs to a hosting or VPN provider (see description of is_anonymous_vpn).

is_public_proxy.description: True if the IP address belongs to a public prox.y

is_tor_exit_node.description: True if the IP address is a Tor exit node.

description: The recent analysis of the target IP indicates that it is classified as an anonymous address. However, it is not tied to any registered anonymous VPN service, and the evidence points to the IP belonging to a hosting or VPN provider rather than a typical consumer network. Additionally, there are no signs that the address functions as a public proxy, nor does it appear to be operating as a Tor exit node.
